hero.subtitle: Where aesthetics is not the goal, but the natural result of a competent technical process.

projects.title: Parfume. Simulation
projects.description: Product visualization of a perfume bottle — flow simulation, glass reflections, soft studio light.
projects.assignment: Make a static bottle feel like a living material — without a shoot, without props. The image had to read in product retail and in social feeds at the same time.
projects.solution: Houdini solver handles fluid and splash, Blender finishes shading and rendering, DaVinci Resolve carries the grade. One setup delivers a series of angles from a single source.
projects.context: Published on Behance in 2025 — reused as a testbed for product-loop renders in the portfolio.

projects.title: Hoodi. Cloth Simulation
projects.description: 3D modeling and cloth simulation in Marvelous Designer and Blender — product visualization of a hoodie.
projects.assignment: Translate a hoodie product photo into pure CG — material, folds, fit. Keep the cut recognisable and the fabric character intact.
projects.solution: Base pattern is built in Marvelous Designer, with folds and seams reworked in Blender. Shading runs on physically-based fabric maps.
projects.context: The approach is reused as a template for product graphics for apparel brands.

projects.title: ThyName. Animation
projects.description: Brand 3D animation — motion design in Blender, compositing in After Effects, finishing grade in DaVinci Resolve.
projects.assignment: Build a short brand film that holds rhythm and reads on any screen — from a phone feed to a large monitor.
projects.solution: Modeling and animation in Blender, post in After Effects (light comp, grain, vignette), finished with a calm grade in DaVinci Resolve — no aggressive contrast.
projects.context: Used in social channels and as the title shot on the brand's site.

projects.title: Batara Travel
projects.description: 2D motion design for a travel agency — frame-by-frame brand storytelling assembled in After Effects.
projects.assignment: Translate the agency's identity into a short looping spot that reads on social feeds and on partner LED screens.
projects.solution: Layout, animation and final grade live in After Effects. The cut keeps a calm rhythm so the type and the destinations remain the lead actors.
projects.context: Used by the agency in social channels and inside their offline presentations.

projects.title: MetallPlace
projects.description: Two motion design pieces for an industrial marketplace — a short brand loop and a long-form lecture cut.
projects.assignment: Two formats from the same visual system: a punchy brand loop for digital touchpoints, and an explainer for an internal lecture.
projects.solution: Built on a shared 2D toolkit in After Effects so both pieces share rhythm, palette, and typography while serving very different runtimes.
projects.context: Used on the company's public channels and during their training sessions.

projects.title: Cosmos. Moscow
projects.description: 2D motion design loop developed for a Moscow Government cultural project on the topic of space.
projects.assignment: Build a calm, looping piece on the theme of cosmos — to be projected during a city cultural event for a wide audience.
projects.solution: A draft loop set the rhythm and palette; the final piece extends the system into a longer, more textured cut with sound, designed to live as a continuous projection.
projects.context: Produced as part of a Moscow Government cultural programme.

approach_steps.title: Discovery
approach_steps.description: Kickoff call to align on goals, scope, audience, budget and timeline.
approach_steps.deliverable: A written brief covering goals, audience, scope, budget and timeline — ready to act on.

approach_steps.title: Moodboard & References
approach_steps.description: Visual research and neural references. We lock the mood before any animation.
approach_steps.deliverable: An approved moodboard with the exact reference frames the film will live in.

approach_steps.title: Animatic
approach_steps.description: Low-fi edit — timing, rhythm and camera work. You approve the cut before lookdev.
approach_steps.deliverable: An approved cut: timing, rhythm and camera framing locked before any expensive lookdev.

approach_steps.title: Lookdev & Lighting
approach_steps.description: Shading, lighting, FX and preview renders with comp passes — sent over for sign-off.
approach_steps.deliverable: Composited preview renders showing exactly how every shot will read at final quality.

approach_steps.title: Final Render
approach_steps.description: Graded master plus cut-downs for every platform. Documented project files included.
approach_steps.deliverable: A graded master plus cut-downs for every platform, with documented project files.
